deliberate_knowledge_rule_shared_with_v4.why: sign-flip quarantine (knowledge.is_sign_flip): a re-report with the same magnitude and opposite sign is treated as a tagging error and the FIRST-seen sign is kept

_coarser_rounding treated a 10-K quarterly-note 50,000,000 as a coarser rounding of the 10-Q's 51,000,000 (trailing zero makes 50M look stated in tens of millions); the precise-first value was kept. KNOWN LIMITATION: a 2% single-quarter difference
